messages:
ana: Heads up — agg-hours shows a hole for 2026-03-07 00:00-06:00 UTC. Looks like a batch of EU telemetry arrived after our compute cutoff. I started an ad-hoc backfill but it's thrashing parquet shuffle and eating cluster slots. anyone on reprocess config?
chris: I saw the alert. Did you run the usual reprocess-runner or the streaming catchup?
nana: sorry typo — i started reprocess-runner (spark) with default chunking. kicked it off at 1842003600. ops-bot reported high executor GC and many small tasks.
ops-bot: Job telemetry-recompute started by ana (id: tr-20260307-01). status: running. allocated: 48 executors.
lee: small tasks cause overhead. We should increase chunk_ms and reduce max_concurrent_chunks. Current defaults are too aggressive for EU spikes.
maria: agree. Also curious if the late events are duplicates — we need idempotent joins on event_id before aggregating.
chris: can you paste the job config you used?
nana: pasted below: ```
job: telemetry-recompute
window: 2026-03-07T00:00Z/2026-03-07T06:00Z
chunk_ms: 600000
max_concurrent_chunks: 12
shuffle_partitions: 200
```
lee: ok that explains it. chunk_ms=600k + 12 concurrent = lots of tiny tasks. try chunk_ms=3600000 and max_concurrent_chunks=6. also bump shuffle_partitions to 800 for fewer small files.
chris: +1. Also, we should route these backfills to the backfill-gpu pool (lower priority) instead of default inference pool. Avoid interfering with Dedicated customers.
maria: is there an automatic queuing threshold we can use? last time we had customer impact during a replay.
lee: we talked about a queuing policy months ago — threshold by cpu_seconds or by slot_count. right now it's static. propose: if job.type==backfill and estimated_slots>24, route to backfill-pool.
nana: estimate for current job was ~48 slots, so it would've switched. we need a quick patch + rollout.
chris: who owns routing policy service? @lee?
lee: i'll own a small patch to policy: add rule backfill_high_slot -> route backfill-pool. quick test locally then canary to staging.
maria: timeline?
lee: I can open PR in ~30m. need approval on default thresholds. propose threshold 24 slots or 1800 cpu_seconds/min. open to tweak.
chris: 24 seems reasonable. Also add a safety cap to concurrent backfills per region (EU/NA) = 2 each to avoid double-hit.
nana: sounds good. can we also change reprocess-runner default chunks for ad-hoc runs to 1h? majority of these backfills are short windows.
lee: will include that config change. also add a fallback: if shuffle spill rate > 0.2 then auto-throttle by halving concurrent_chunks.
ops-bot: Deployment pipeline: PR 6123 created by lee -> routing-service. CI checks queued.
maria: can someone run a dry-run on this job with the new chunking config before we change routing? small window replay for 1h should be cheap.
nana: running dry-run now with chunk_ms=3600000, max_concurrent_chunks=6. will post logs.
chris: also create a ticket to track cost and customer impact: PLATFORM-3941. Add notes about parquet file count, shuffle bytes, and KAFKA lag root cause.
maria: tagging SRE for follow-up on why EU ingestion was delayed. could be regional connector backpressure.
lee: quick checklist I plan to PR:
- add routing rule backfill_high_slot (threshold=24)
- default reprocess-runner chunk_ms=3600000 for ad-hoc
- auto-throttle on spill_rate > 0.2
- cap concurrent backfills per region=2
will include unit tests + integration job sim.
nana: awesome. after dry-run finishes i'll post numbers. if green, let's merge and canary. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Job telemetry-recompute (tr-20260307-01) dry-run completed. summary: tasks reduced by 6x, shuffle_bytes down 78%, runtime 2.1h -> 0.45h.
chris: great results. lee please proceed with PR and add a staged rollout (10% of backfills -> 100% over 24h).
maria: thanks everyone. i'll follow up with SRE on ingestion root cause.
lee: PR 6123 updated with canary rollout plan. cc @ana for verification.
nana: verified dry-run artifacts and parquet counts look good. marking job done and closing the ad-hoc run.
chris: filing short retro note in #eng-platform-postmortems about improving telemetry SLA and adding observability for backfill impact.
maria: filing PLATFORM-3941 with links to job logs and PR.
ops-bot: PR 6123 merged by ci-bot. routing-service deployed to staging.
lee: will ship to prod after 1h canary.
nana: thanks all!
